r.경제 체제: Market economy · chemicals, pharmaceuticals, port of Antwerp
r.주식시장 시가총액: $321.1 billion, 59% of GDP (2018, listed domestic companies)
r.빅맥지수: $7.08 for a Big Mac, $0.86 more than in the US (Jul 2026, The Economist, euro-area average)
r.생활 물가 수준: 87% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.주요 수출품: Pharmaceuticals 16%, Cars 11%, Oil, fuels, gas, coal 10%, Machinery, computers 7%, Plastics 5% (2025, share of all exports, top 5)
r.한국이 파는 것: Excavators and construction machinery 18%, Cars 14%, Plastics 13%, Other iron and steel 6% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Vaccines, blood products 16%, Pharmaceuticals 8%, Gold, precious metals, gems 7%, Cars 6% (2025, share of value)
r.한국과 맺은 FTA: Korea-EU FTA (provisionally applied 2011, fully in force 2015)
r.정치 구도: A federal constitutional monarchy split between Dutch- and French-speaking communities; forming a government often takes a long time.

t.why: The center of European politics and diplomacy.
t.rel: The 'capital of Europe', home to the headquarters of the EU and NATO. Divided between Dutch- and French-speaking communities, it often takes a long time to form a government.
t.korea: It fought in the Korean War.
t.know: In the village of Baarle-Hertog, the border with the Netherlands runs between houses, and the front door decides which country a house is in.
t.etext: In the middle of Europe, logistics, chemicals and pharmaceuticals have grown up around the port of Antwerp. With EU institutions clustered in Brussels, there are many jobs in international organizations and services.
